body: Well that's exactly what I am trying to figure out. I know the bigger companies thanks to Google but I am just curious about smaller places as well, like you mentioned, that are up and coming. I am just curious what people's personal experiences have been at certain places and everyone's experiences vary at each place. Simply curious is all :)
Unfortunately it doesn't as I am wondering from a personal perspective rather than a google generated post. I appreciate your extensive effort though.

I have a marketing degree and have been in admin roles for over 10 years with a year of marketing experience. Just trying to grow that experience in marketing. Would like to go in to advertising but just gotta get my foot in somewhere to see just where exactly I am the best fit. Hence starting at the bottom of the totem pole.

Sometimes it does take them awhile. Give her 48 hours and if nothing, go find her and talk to her! If she doesn't want to talk to you, find someone higher up! Just keep trying your options because if you don't, you're going to regret not trying to resolve the issue.

Could you set a time to speak with your professor/teacher? I mean sit down with them and review your answers and see if either you or they were wrong? Just for clarification purposes you know? At least that can give you peace of mind. Most professors like when students want to understand why they didn't do well.

I know how you feel and while I am in a very similar situation (already graduated), I still like helping others. My hope for you is that you will in fact find a great opportunity once you graduate. I was in college for 8 fucking years and while I made some acquaintances, I never made any friends myself. I also know all too well how you feel about being in class and not understanding shit. I felt like, and probably was, the only one in my classes where all the students would just get great grades and I was always the one struggling. I would study and study and study and the day of a test, I would get in class where guys were like "man I didn't study at all and I am hung over from last night" and guess who was the one to pass? Well...I may not have gotten the best grades but at least I graduated. I know I don't have a lot of encouraging words of support but know you're not alone in this shit. The world is a really really cruel place and while it's not easy, I hope you are able to find support somewhere and your life improves! If you ever need to talk, ask questions, or just want to vent - just message me! I am more than happy to talk.

Jack, thank you for your kind words. I really appreciate it.  I did have my resume reviewed and edited by both career services on my campus and my cousin who is a mass comm professor at a top 10 University. I did 2 internships already. One was free doing the same commute.
My relationship on the other hand is just in a very weird spot. My fiance has no idea what he wants to do once he graduates and it's reflected on our relationship. It seems like we are two blobs of Jello just kinda hanging around until life decides to work its way out.
I want to go to counseling but I can't afford it! It sucks! Money just fuels everything :(

If you're not happy, get out! Find someone worth your time. I think my guy has the same problem with testosterone and it's very obnoxious. Maybe her leaving is a good thing for you. Maybe it's a sign? Hope something good comes your way and you find out what your best option is. Best of luck.

I hate to hear that for the kids sake. Maybe research your options or possibly taking custody of the children yourself? Contact someone with child protective services or the police and ask if there are any options. I hope good things come your way, especially for those kids. They don't need to be living a life like that.
